advisories.summary: Apache Commons Lang is vulnerable to Uncontrolled Recursion when processing long inputs
advisories.description:
Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in Apache Commons Lang.

This issue affects Apache Commons Lang: Starting with commons-lang:commons-lang 2.0 to 2.6, and, from org.apache.commons:commons-lang3 3.0 before 3.18.0.

The methods ClassUtils.getClass(...) can throw StackOverflowError on very long inputs. Because an Error is usually not handled by applications and libraries, a StackOverflowError could cause an application to stop.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.18.0, which fixes the issue.

advisories.summary: jose4j is vulnerable to DoS via compressed JWE content
advisories.description: In jose4j before 0.9.6, an attacker can cause a Denial-of-Service (DoS) condition by crafting a malicious JSON Web Encryption (JWE) token with an exceptionally high compression ratio. When this token is processed by the server, it results in significant memory allocation and processing time during decompression.

cwes.name: Improper Restriction of Security Token Assignment

advisories.summary: Bouncy Castle Crypto Package For Java: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerability in bcpkix modules
advisories.description:
: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerability in Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. BC-JAVA bcpkix on all (pkix modules).


PKIX draft CompositeVerifier accepts empty signature sequence as valid.


This issue affects BC-JAVA: from 1.49 before 1.84.

cwes.name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

advisories.summary: Bouncy Castle: Lazy ASN.1 sequence forcing resets nesting-depth guard
advisories.description: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.85, Lazy ASN.1 sequence forcing resets nesting-depth guard. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.12, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 1.0.2.7 (1.0.X series), 2.0.2 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.3 (2.1.X series).

advisories.summary: Bouncy Castle: Name Constraints bypass via trailing dot in rfc822Name and URI
advisories.description: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.85, Name Constraints bypass via trailing dot in rfc822Name and URI. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.12, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 1.0.2.7 (1.0.X series), 2.0.2 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.3 (2.1.X series).

advisories.summary: Bouncy Castle has an LDAP injection
advisories.description:
Improper neutralization of special elements used in an LDAP query ('LDAP injection') vulnerability in Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. BC-JAVA bcprov on all (prov modules). This vulnerability is associated with program files LDAPStoreHelper.

This issue affects BC-JAVA: from 1.74 before 1.84.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

advisories.summary: Bouncy Castle for Java GOST 28147 CTR mode reuses keystream after 255 blocks
advisories.description: The GOST 28147-2015 CTR mode implementation (`G3413CTRBlockCipher`) in the Legion of the Bouncy Castle BC-JAVA `bcprov` core module only increments the final byte of the counter, so the counter wraps after 255 blocks and the keystream is reused. Reusing CTR keystream allows an attacker who can observe two ciphertexts produced with the same key/IV to recover the XOR of the plaintexts, breaking confidentiality. Affects BC-JAVA from 1.59 before 1.84 (with backported fixes in 1.80.2 and 1.81.1).

cwes.name: Reusing a Nonce, Key Pair in Encryption
Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

advisories.summary: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection in JDOM
advisories.description: An XXE issue in SAXBuilder in JDOM through 2.0.6 allows attackers to cause a denial of service via a crafted HTTP request. As a workaround, to avoid external entities being expanded, one can call `builder.setExpandEntities(false)` and they won't be expanded.

cwes.name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

advisories.summary: JetBrains Kotlin: Unsafe Deserialization in Kotlin Build Cache Enables Code Execution
advisories.description: In JetBrains Kotlin before 2.4.20 code execution was possible via unsafe deserialization in the build cache metadata
